notes: Sydney/NSW banking calendar, including the August bank holiday and October Labour Day. It is not a universal Australian state or ASX trading calendar. Modern Australia Day observance is January 26, Mondayized only on weekends; exceptional historical notices require dated maintenance. The ANZAC Additional Days of 2026-04-27 and 2027-04-26 are dated NSW additions under the published two-year trial (record CORE-CONVENTIONS-005 #3); they are not extrapolated to later years and do not apply to the separate ASX convention.
